privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'HeLa Cells' sample in Fiji is a 48-bit RGB (16-bits per channel) fluorescence image. Colour Deconvolution is a specific plugin found under Image > Color > Colour Deconvolution. When run, it typically generates three new image windows. The task specifically requires saving the first (Colour_1) and second (Colour_2) channels. Note that while the plugin is designed for histological stains, it is being applied here to a fluorescence sample as per the task instructions.
